name: Anthropic API (Claude Console)
how_to_set: Create a workspace per app; Workspace > Limits > Change Limit: set a monthly spend limit (must be below the organization limit).
Add an email notification below the limit.
kill_switch: Workspace spend limit rejects requests above it; archive the workspace key to stop at once.
traps: Usage tier maximum is not your limit
Using an API key for Claude Code instead of a subscription bills per token
